extracted.name: Fried Corn with Smoked Sausage
extracted.description: This delicious sausage fry recipe combines corn, onions, green and red bell peppers, and smoked sausage in a delicious one-pot meal.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound smoked sausage, cut into 1-inch pieces
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat. Cook onion, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, and smoked sausage in butter until hot, 1 to 2 minutes.

Add corn to the skillet and reduce heat to medium; cover and cook until corn is tender, 5 to 7 minutes. Season with seasoned salt, garlic powder, onion powder, monosodium glutamate, and pepper; toss to combine. Serve hot.
